dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: How did it get blown up that high...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Honorary Knight. How do you do? So it's like this: you must have seen that storm that surrounded the entire city, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Although the storm has subsided, the effects of that storm aren't going to be fixed any time soon...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Not a few merchants have said that the signboards and posters that they put up outside have all gone with the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Some have ended up on rooftops, others onto the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: The Knights originally intended to send two agile members to settle these issues with haste.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: I mean, besides helping the citizens, we're also concerned that those things would look rather unbecoming, hanging off the roofs and the walls like that.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: But as it turns out, we're shorthanded at the moment, so only I was sent.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: And with these knees of mine, even climbing stairs has become problematic recently. I can't imagine what would become of me if I had to climb up that high...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Could you help me out of this bind, Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be happy to.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'm so sorry, this should have been my job, but...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: There should be three posters and one signboard now stuck on rooftops and on the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Please bring those posters to me. As for the signboard, you can just leave it here on the ground. I'll have my colleagues pass it on to the appropriate merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Again, thank you. You've really saved me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got something else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: It's alright. This was my job in the first place. You do what you have to, I'll think of a way to get this done.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Hello. Any suspicious activity to report?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you on patrol?

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm responsible for security in the vicinity of the Cathedral. I patrol the stairs in front of the Cathedral's entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: I am proud to have this job because I get to guard the Anemo Archon statue. But I must say, these stairs are taking their toll on my knees...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: *sigh* I shudder to think whether I'll be able to keep doing this in ten years' time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: I'll be on the lookout.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: We are currently experiencing abnormal weather patterns. It is dangerous outside. Citizens are advised to seek shelter.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: That dragon could return at any time. The Knights of Favonius will keep watch; everyone else is urged to find shelter immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: This is an emergency. Please be assured that the Knights of Favonius' first priority is to guarantee the safety of everyone in the city.
